items.heading: Most People Frame This As
items.text: Most people frame this as MBA versus certification, as if one is simply the upgraded version of the other. It is not. They are built to solve different problems, and treating them as interchangeable is why so many people either overpay for an MBA they did not need, or collect certifications that never move their salary.

items.heading: Strip Away the Prestige Talk
items.text: Strip away the prestige talk and look at what a resume line actually communicates to the person reading it in thirty seconds.

items.heading: The Gap Here Is Larger
items.text: The gap here is larger than most people expect before they price it out properly.
